scope: Additional arguments, and corrections to mistyped ones, for catalog tools whose exact version is pinned in toolchains/*.tsv. Authored for AI-tricky and checked against each pinned binary's help output. Not part of the pinned mini-tricky migration.

args.label: Sources
args.description: Comma-separated passive sources to use, for example crtsh,github.

args.label: Exclude Sources
args.description: Comma-separated passive sources to skip.

args.label: Rate Limit
args.description: Maximum HTTP requests per second across all sources.

args.label: Per-Source Rate Limits
args.description: Per-source request limits in key=value form, for example hackertarget=10/m.

args.label: Exclude IPs
args.description: Drop IP addresses from the discovered names.

args.label: Max Results per Source
args.description: Limit results per source; 0 means unlimited.

args.label: Max Enumeration Time
args.description: Minutes to wait for enumeration results.

args.label: Response Size Limit
args.description: Maximum response body bytes read from a source; 0 means unlimited.

args.label: Concurrency
args.description: Concurrent probes, split between HTTPS and HTTP.

args.label: Timeout
args.description: Probe timeout in milliseconds.

args.label: Prefer HTTPS
args.description: Try plain HTTP only when HTTPS fails.

args.label: Skip Default Probes
args.description: Skip the default http:80 and https:443 probes; use with extra ports.

args.label: Match Lines
args.description: Match responses by line count.

args.label: Match Words
args.description: Match responses by word count.

args.label: Match Size
args.description: Match responses by size in bytes.

args.label: Match Regexp
args.description: Match responses whose content matches this regular expression.

args.label: Match Time
args.description: Match by milliseconds to the first response byte, for example >100 or <100.

args.label: Matcher Mode
args.description: How matchers combine: and, or.

args.label: Filter Lines
args.description: Filter out responses by line count; comma-separated counts and ranges.

args.label: Filter Words
args.description: Filter out responses by word count; comma-separated counts and ranges.

args.label: Filter Time
args.description: Filter by milliseconds to the first response byte, for example >100 or <100.

args.label: Filter Mode
args.description: How filters combine: and, or.

args.label: Request Timeout
args.description: HTTP request timeout in seconds.

args.label: Max Run Time
args.description: Maximum running time in seconds for the whole process; 0 means no limit.

args.label: Max Job Time
args.description: Maximum running time in seconds per job; 0 means no limit.

args.label: Request Delay
args.description: Seconds between requests, or a random range such as 0.1-2.0.

args.label: Stop on All Errors
args.description: Stop on every error case; implies stop on flood and stop on errors.

args.label: Per-Host Calibration
args.description: Calibrate automatic filtering separately for each host.

args.label: Recursion Strategy
args.description: Which matches start a recursive job: default or greedy (every match).

args.label: Extensions
args.description: Comma-separated extensions appended to each candidate, for example .php,.bak.

args.label: Ignore Comments
args.description: Ignore comment lines in the bound list.

args.label: DirSearch Mode
args.description: DirSearch compatibility mode; use together with extensions.

args.label: Ignore Body
args.description: Do not fetch response content.

args.label: HTTP/2
args.description: Use the HTTP/2 protocol.

corrections.description: Also crawl robots.txt and sitemap.xml entries: all, robotstxt or sitemapxml. Needs a depth of at least 3.
corrections.label: Robots and Sitemap

corrections.description: Comma-separated extensions to drop from the output, for example png,css.

args.label: jsluice Parsing
args.description: Parse JavaScript with jsluice for more endpoints; memory intensive.

args.label: Crawl Duration
args.description: Maximum time to crawl each target, for example 90s, 10m or 1h.

args.label: Retries
args.description: Times to retry a failed request.

args.label: Visit Strategy
args.description: Crawl order: depth-first or breadth-first.

args.label: Ignore Query Params
args.description: Do not re-crawl the same location with different query values.

args.label: Filter Similar URLs
args.description: Skip URLs that look alike, such as /users/123 and /users/456.

args.label: Similar URL Threshold
args.description: Distinct values before a URL position is treated as a parameter.

args.label: Climb Parent Locations
args.description: Also crawl the parent of each discovered URL; the crawl scope still applies.

args.label: Max Pages per Domain
args.description: Maximum pages to crawl per domain.

args.label: Exclude Hosts
args.description: Skip hosts matching a filter: cdn, private-ips, a CIDR, an IP or a regex.

args.label: Extension Match
args.description: Only output URLs with these extensions, for example php,html,js.

args.label: No Default Extension Filter
args.description: Keep extensions that are filtered out by default.

args.label: Disable Unique Filter
args.description: Keep pages with duplicate content.

args.label: Similar Page Filter
args.description: Filter pages whose content is similar after exact de-duplication.

args.label: Parallelism
args.description: Concurrent inputs to process.

args.label: Request Delay
args.description: Seconds to wait between requests.

args.label: Rate Limit per Minute
args.description: Maximum requests per minute.

args.label: Host Rate Limit
args.description: Maximum requests per second for each host.

args.label: Host Rate Limit per Minute
args.description: Maximum requests per minute for each host.

args.label: Exclude Severity
args.description: Skip templates of these severities: info, low, medium, high, critical, unknown.

args.label: Protocol Types
args.description: Run only templates of these protocol types, for example http,dns,ssl.

args.label: Exclude Protocol Types
args.description: Skip templates of these protocol types, for example dns,tcp.

args.label: Template IDs
args.description: Run only these template IDs (comma-separated; wildcards allowed).

args.label: Exclude Template IDs
args.description: Skip these template IDs (comma-separated).

args.label: Authors
args.description: Run only templates by these authors (comma-separated).

args.label: Exclude Hosts
args.description: Hosts to skip from the input: IP, CIDR or hostname.

args.label: IP Version
args.description: IP versions to scan for a hostname: 4, 6 or 4,6.

args.label: Rate Limit Window
args.description: Time window the rate limit applies to, for example 1s or 1m.

args.label: Template Request Concurrency
args.description: Maximum concurrent request variations for each template.

args.label: Probe Concurrency
args.description: Concurrency of the HTTP probe used for non-URL input.

args.label: Timeout
args.description: Seconds to wait before a request times out.

args.label: Retries
args.description: Times to retry a failed request.

args.label: Max Host Errors
args.description: Errors for one host before it is skipped.

args.label: Keep Failing Hosts
args.description: Do not skip hosts because of repeated errors.

args.label: Stop at First Match
args.description: Stop HTTP requests for a template after its first match; may break multi-step templates.

args.label: Scan Strategy
args.description: Scan order: auto, host-spray or template-spray.

args.label: Leave Default Ports
args.description: Keep default ports in targets, for example host:80 and host:443.

args.label: No HTTP Probe
args.description: Do not probe non-URL input before scanning.

args.label: Disable Clustering
args.description: Send each template request separately instead of clustering identical ones.

args.label: Block Local Network
args.description: Block connections to local and private network addresses.

args.label: Response Size Limit
args.description: Maximum response size to read, in bytes.

args.label: Force HTTP/2
args.description: Force HTTP/2 connections.
